atrium/to-forest.reply: The marble surround every upstairs door shares is rebuilt as real moulding: a swept architrave (reveal, stepped fascias, brass bead, curved cyma), plinths, a flared keystone and a two-part cornice. And yes to the PNG: draw over docs/door-frames/template-upstairs.png and see docs/door-frames.md. Your frame gets a sliding glint and the portal glows through its soft edges.

history.reply: Warm and airy now: honey lantern light, three faceted rupees (green, blue, red) turning slowly, a heart drifting up, sparkles. The frame is a little shop front: wooden posts, a striped scalloped awning, a sign with the name and rupees, paper lanterns, Zelda pots. The shop itself got bunting, paper lanterns, pots, barrels, crates, an awning over the counter, round windows, and brighter, warmer light.
